title: LagNet: Lag-Structured Operators for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.23735v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting maps a finite history window to an extended future horizon. Many existing models focus primarily on the design of input representations and model structures, while paying less attention to the structural form of the history-to-future forecasting operator itself. We examine this operator directly and find that, across model families, sensitivity matrices exhibit recurring diagonal patterns whose diagonals correspond to relative temporal lags. Motivated by this observation, we develop a framework for direct multi-step forecasting based on lag-structured temporal operators. Its basic building block, LagLayer, constructs a Toeplitz matrix by tying history-to-future connections with the same relative lag and incorporates horizon-wise and history-wise scaling coefficients to relax exact sharing. This design enables LagLayer to serve as an effective replacement for temporal linear layers in existing forecasting

translated_title: LagNet：用于长期时间序列预测的滞后结构算子
translated_abstract: 长期时间序列预测是将有限的历史窗口映射到延展的未来时间段。许多现有模型主要关注输入表示和模型结构的设计，而对历史到未来预测算子本身的结构形式关注较少。我们直接考察这一算子，发现跨不同模型族中，敏感度矩阵呈现出反复出现的对角模式，其对角线对应于相对时间滞后。受此观察启发，我们开发了一个基于滞后结构时间算子的直接多步预测框架。其基本构建模块 LagLayer 通过将具有相同相对滞后的历史到未来连接绑定在一起来构建 Toeplitz 矩阵，并引入按预测视界和按历史的缩放系数来放宽严格的权重共享。这一设计使 LagLayer 能够作为现有预测模型中时间线性层的有效替代。
tldr: 该论文通过直接考察预测算子发现其敏感度矩阵存在对应相对时间滞后的对角模式，据此提出基于 Toeplitz 矩阵的 LagLayer 模块，可作为现有时间序列预测模型中时间线性层的有效替代。
